messages.subject: Newbie question
parts:
Not sure why my textbox isn't being updated.  Obviously missing something obvious.

Thanks in advance.

library("shiny")
runApp(list(
  ui = fluidPage(           
  tags$textarea(id="textbox2",  rows=3, cols=140, "abc")
  ),
  
  server = function(input, output, session){
    
    output$textbox2 <- renderPrint({
      "123"
      })

    
    observe({
      output$textbox2 <- renderPrint({
        "123"
      })
    })
  }

))
